To avoid surprises in the Compiler's "Steel Proof", check the deterministic map generated by `dependency-cruiser`.

*(Warning: If the JSON does not exist, do not worry. The Guardian will require `npm run sync-twin` to be executed in the mission's Closing Batch).*
